summary: CRM module (customers, properties, equipment, communications, files, timeline, AI summary, tenant isolation) tested end-to-end. Backend: 17 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_phase_crm.py — all pass. Full regression: 94/94 tests green (77 prior + 17 new). Frontend: /app/customers list (search, status pills, tag pills, add-customer modal), /app/customers/:id detail (all 5 tabs, status select, quick notes save, AI briefing with REAL Claude Sonnet 4.5 content rendered, property add modal) all verified via Playwright. Auto job→comm logs verified: POST /api/jobs with customer_id creates 'Job created: <title>' system communication; PATCH /api/jobs/{id} {status:'completed'} creates 'Job completed: <title>'. Timeline merges jobs+comms+files sorted ts desc. Tenant isolation enforced across customers/properties/equipment/timeline. AI summary returns {summary, model:'claude-sonnet-4-5'} with real LLM output (verified live screenshot of 4-line briefing).

issues: Visual: the 'Log touchpoint' / add-communication CTA may not be prominent enough when timeline is empty. Playwright timed out locating data-testid='add-communication-button' inside the History tab during the empty-state — main agent should verify it renders unconditionally (code at line 192 of CustomerDetail.jsx looks unconditional but could be positioned outside the viewport in the empty state).

action_items: Optional UX: surface the 'Add communication' button more prominently in the History tab empty-state (it's there in code; ensure scroll/position doesn't hide it).
Optional API consistency: GET /api/customers/{id}/timeline returns 100 events max via ?limit; consider documenting and adding a 'has_more' flag.

Optional: AI summary endpoint returns model:'claude-sonnet-4-5' but the underlying model the integration uses is `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` — consider returning the full model name for traceability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1696 lines — still well past the 700 threshold (refactor recommended; CRM module alone added ~200 lines).

POST /api/jobs auto-creates a system communication on the customer; PATCH only fires the 'Job completed' comm when status==completed. No equivalent 'Job scheduled', 'Job in_progress', or 'Job cancelled' events. Consider broadening for richer timeline.

DELETE /api/properties/{property_id} cascades equipment deletion correctly. However DELETE /api/equipment/{equipment_id} does NOT verify equipment belongs to a property the user can see — it scopes by company_id only, which is fine, but the property_id check on POST suggests this should symmetrically scope on customer_id on DELETE for consistency.
/api/customers list returns all matching rows up to limit=200 with no total/count field; the UI displays a count from items.length which understates large result sets.
/api/customers/{id}/files DELETE returns 200 on success but the file blob is NOT removed from object storage — only the DB record. Potential storage leak.

/api/customers/{id}/summary catches any exception and returns a fallback string with model=None. Good fail-soft, but the underlying error is only logged once — consider returning an error_code so the UI can distinguish 'no key configured' vs 'transient LLM failure'.
Communications insert does not record an updated_at; if a comm is ever edited (no PATCH endpoint exists), audit will be missing.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% — list/search/filter, add-customer, detail header, tabs, AI summary, notes, property add all PASS. Communication add timed out finding button in empty History tab (likely test-timing not a defect — verify manually).
